query: Who is on today's daily team?
expected_behavior: Prints the team, constraint, and task from team.sh as written
Does not read prompt.md, write a session, or build anything

query: /daily-team A tip splitter for three friends who each ordered different things
expected_behavior: Reads the Work the brief and Writing rules sections of prompt.md
Writes Pitch, Clash, then Decision or Deadlock, then Build notes, under those headings
The Clash has 6 to 10 lines and no member speaks more than 3 times
A Deadlock is ruled on once with the Referee section, and the session ends with a Decision
Uses none of the banned words and no exclamation marks or emoji
Works today's task, since no brief is given
Writes team-builds/<date>/artifact-1.html led by member 1 and artifact-2.html led by member 2
Each file has a title, a viewport meta tag, and no external scripts, styles, fonts, images, forms, or network calls
Each file shows the decision's concept on the first screen and ends with a credits line
Each file updates its result as the user changes an input, without a submit button, and uses short labels instead of instruction paragraphs
Reviews each file against the review list, fixes what fails, and only then gives the paths
Does not run daily.sh or recruit.sh
